title: Generic guidance (no tooling assumed)
note: Tool-neutral next steps. Organisations replace or extend this pack with their own automation.

ci.title: Extend the CI pipeline
ci.does: Add the missing stage or job to the existing CI system and make it a required check.

tests.title: Add the missing tests
tests.does: Write the tests in the team's existing framework and run them in CI.

scan.title: Run a vulnerability scan
scan.does: Run the organisation's approved scanner against the repository and record the result.

upgrade.title: Plan a platform upgrade
upgrade.does: Run change impact for the target version, then upgrade behind the test safety net.

deploy_config.title: Change the deployment configuration
deploy_config.does: Update the deployment definition that runs the application: Kubernetes or Helm files, a Nomad job, Ansible inventories and roles, or the platform repository that owns them.

app_config.title: Change the application configuration
app_config.does: Update the application's configuration and verify in a non-production environment.

docs.title: Document it in the repository
docs.does: Add or complete the file next to the code: a README that says what the application does, a CODEOWNERS file, an ADR.

deps_bot.title: Turn on dependency update pull requests
deps_bot.does: Add a Renovate or Dependabot configuration so outdated dependencies arrive as reviewed pull requests.

alias.title: Resolve unmatched calls
alias.does: Add the missing repositories to the analysis, or supply an alias file (host: application), then re-run.

http_timeouts.title: Set HTTP client timeouts
http_timeouts.does: Give every outbound HTTP client a connect and a read (response) timeout shorter than the caller's own deadline, in configuration (e.g. spring.http.client.*, feign.client.config.*) or on the client builder.

resilience_lib.title: Add retries and circuit breakers
resilience_lib.does: Wrap each remote dependency in a circuit breaker and retry only idempotent calls, with bounded attempts and backoff (e.g. Resilience4j).

dead_letter.title: Handle failing messages
dead_letter.does: Configure the consumer's error handler with bounded retries and a dead-letter topic or queue, and alert on messages arriving there.

db_timeouts.title: Bound database calls
db_timeouts.does: Set a query or transaction timeout (and size the connection pool) so a slow query cannot hold a connection indefinitely.

graceful_shutdown_upgrade.title: Upgrade, then enable graceful shutdown
graceful_shutdown_upgrade.does: This Spring Boot line has no graceful shutdown setting: upgrade to a supported line (2.3 or later is the minimum), then set server.shutdown=graceful and a shutdown phase timeout.

graceful_shutdown.title: Enable graceful shutdown
graceful_shutdown.does: Set server.shutdown=graceful (or the framework's equivalent) and a shutdown phase timeout below the platform's termination grace period. On Spring Boot older than 2.3 the property does not exist: upgrade first.

secrets.title: Rotate and externalise the secrets
secrets.does: Rotate every exposed secret first (it is in the history), then load it at runtime from the platform's secret store (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Kubernetes Secrets) or the CI credential store; add secret scanning so it does not happen again.

json_logs.title: Log as JSON
json_logs.does: Switch the log output to JSON (logging.structured.format.console on Spring Boot 3.4+, or a JSON encoder) and include trace and correlation identifiers.
